mapper.select: SELECT at.*, a.agent_name, a.agent_code, t.task_name, t.task_code FROM quality_agent_task at LEFT JOIN quality_agent a ON a.id = at.agent_id LEFT JOIN quality_task t ON t.id = at.task_id WHERE at.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY at.id DESC
